method: Two fixed-scene replays. While the closed-target brick origin was more than 40.5 mm above the tabletop, sample its position in the robot tool frame or gripper hand frame; report per-axis peak-to-peak ranges. The samples are not an applied disturbance or a finger contact-force measurement.
joint_observation: During the third brick grasp, the physics-callback readings around 6.22-6.34 s reported position near -0.3438 rad and velocity near +1.7908 rad/s. These values are inconsistent with a simple finite-difference interpretation and need further diagnosis.
